segments.an4.109:1.8: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro rukkhūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.an4.109:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo;
segments.an4.109:2.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo pheggu hoti phegguparivāro.
segments.an4.109:2.5: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, rukkho pheggu phegguparivāro;
segments.an4.109:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo;
segments.an4.109:3.3: parisā ca khvassa hoti sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā.
segments.an4.109:3.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo pheggu hoti sāraparivāro.
segments.an4.109:3.5: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, rukkho pheggu sāraparivāro;
segments.an4.109:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo;
segments.an4.109:4.3: parisā ca khvassa hoti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
segments.an4.109:4.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo sāro hoti phegguparivāro.
segments.an4.109:4.5: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, rukkho sāro phegguparivāro;
segments.an4.109:5.2: Idha bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo;
segments.an4.109:5.4: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo sāro hoti sāraparivāro.
segments.an4.109:5.5: Seyyathāpi so, bhikkhave, rukkho sāro sāraparivāro;
segments.an4.109:5.7: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro rukkhūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmi”nti [pu. pa. 170].

lines: Navame pheggu phegguparivāroti nissāro pheggurukkho pheggurukkheheva parivuto.
Navame rukkho tāva pheggu sāraparivāroti vanajeṭṭhakarukkho sayaṃ pheggu hoti, parivārarukkhā panassa sārā honti.
Puggalesu pana sīlasāravirahitato pheggutā, sīlācārasamannāgamena ca sāratā veditabbā.
